pageSummary: This is a Spanish local service page for an Endesa office at Calle Rambla de San Sebastián, 42, Santa Coloma De Gramenet, Barcelona. It presents nearby Endesa services such as energy, solar panels, and electric mobility, and includes a call to action to request an appointment. The page also mentions that there is no permanence and that users can change tariffs or companies without penalty.
